✨ Rich and decadent molten lava cakes filled with a silky gooey chocolate filling. These lave cakes are super easy to make with just 5 ingredients in under 20 minutes. They make a delicious dessert or Valentine’s day treat! 📌Full printable recipe with tips for different size bowls and alternatives is on my website gimmedelicious.com (link in bio)  Ingredients  ▢ 4 oz bittersweet chocolate ▢ 4 oz butter ▢ 2 large eggs ▢ 1/2 cup sugar ▢ 2 Tablespoons flour ▢ 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ▢ 1/2 teaspoon Instant coffee or espresso powder, optional   Instructions  Preheat oven to 400°F. Generously butter and dust 4 (4 oz) ramekins with cocoa powder or sugar; set aside. In a medium microwave-safe bowl, melt chocolate and butter in 30-second increments. In a separate large bowl, whisk the eggs and sugar until pale and fluffy. Whisk in the melted chocolate along with the flour, vanilla, and instant coffee if desired. Divide batter into ramekins and place them on a baking sheet. Bake 10-12 minutes or until the edges begin to pull away from the ramekins but the center is still jiggly. Remove from oven and serve immediately with ice cream. #recipes #chocolate #lavacakes #valentinesday #food #baking #bakersoftiktok #bakingrecipe

3 Michelin Star Valentine's Day Dessert (at home) Chocolate Lava Cakes (Jean-Georges Inspired) Ingredients (2 cakes) 	•	¼ cup unsalted butter, cut into cubes 	•	2 oz (about ½ cup) semi-sweet or dark chocolate chips/chunks 	•	1 whole egg + 1 egg yolk 	•	2 tbsp sugar 	•	1 tsp flour, plus extra for dusting 	•	Butter for greasing ramekins Steps 	1.	Heat oven to 450°F (230°C). 	2.	Butter two 4-oz ramekins, dust with flour, and tap out excess. 	3.	Melt chocolate (microwave or double boiler). Stir in butter until smooth. 	4.	In a separate bowl, whisk egg, yolk, and sugar until pale. 	5.	Stir egg mixture into melted chocolate, add flour, and whisk to combine. 	6.	Divide batter between ramekins. Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! 🌋🤎 Mini Dark Chocolate Lava Cakes 🤎🌋 Ingredients: 1/2 cup (120 ml) salted butter 6 oz dark chocolate  2 eggs 2 egg yolks 1/4 cup unpacked brown sugar (40g) 2 tbsp flour Pinch of salt For serving: Powdered sugar Vanilla ice cream Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425°F. 2. Grease 6 cups in a standard muffin tin with butter. 3. Melt: Melt butter & chocolate together in a saucepan over low heat, or in the microwave on high. Stir every 30 seconds until smooth.  4. Mix batter: In a medium bowl, beat eggs, egg yolks, brown sugar, & salt until slightly thickened. Whisk in the chocolate mixture. Fold in the flour until just combined. 5. Fill the tin: Divide batter among 6 of the muffin tin cups (about 3/4 full). 6. Bake: Bake for 7–9 minutes. Pull them out as soon as the tops set. 7. Cool & serve: Let sit for 2–3 minutes before serving. Gently remove the cakes from the muffin tin. Serve with a dusting of powdered sugar & vanilla ice cream. Giant Brown Butter Espresso Chocolate Lava Cake Makes 1 x 6” lava cake (perfect for two spoons) Ingredients:      •    100g unsalted butter     •    120g 54% dark chocolate, chopped     •    20g strong espresso or very strong coffee, hot     •    5g freshly ground coffee     •    2 medium eggs     •    2 egg yolks     •    120g caster sugar     •    100g self-raising flour     •    1 tsp vanilla extract     •    Pinch of flaky sea salt     •    Cocoa powder, for dusting the tin Method: 1.     Preheat the oven to 160°C (fan). This batter comes together quickly, so you want the oven ready. 2.    Place the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Cook until it melts, foams, and the milk solids turn golden brown and smell nutty. Remove from the heat immediately. 3.    Add the chopped dark chocolate, hot coffee, ground coffee, vanilla, and flaky salt to the hot browned butter. Stir until the chocolate is fully melted and smooth. Set aside to cool slightly. 4.    In a separate bowl, whisk the eggs, egg yolks, and caster sugar until pale and slightly thickened. This helps create structure while keeping the centre molten. 5.    Stir the flour into the chocolate mixture until just combined. Gently fold the egg mixture into the chocolate in two additions, keeping as much air as possible. 6.    Grease a 6” round tin and dust generously with cocoa powder, tapping out the excess. 7.    Pour the batter into the prepared tin and bake for 18 minutes. The edges should be set, with a soft, slightly wobbly centre. 8.    Rest for 2–3 minutes before serving. Spoon straight from the tin or carefully turn out.

🍫 GÂTEAU VOLCAN  Dimensions du moule ➡️Env. 22 × 18 cm  Ingrédients ➤ Gâteau 	•	3 œufs 	•	170 g d’huile neutre 	•	100g de sucre 	•	75 g de cacao non sucré 	•	240 g d’eau chaude 	•	180 g de farine 	•	15 g de levure chimique 	•	1 c. café rase de bicarbonate ➤ Sirop chocolat 	•	480 g de lait 	•	120 g de cacao 	•	30 g de beurre ➤ Ganache 	•	200 g de chocolat (noir, lait ou mix) 	•	200 g de crème liquide Étapes : Préchauffe ton four à 180°C chaleur tournante. Dans un grand bol, fouette ensemble les œufs, le sucre, l’huile, le cacao et l’eau chaude jusqu’à obtenir une pâte lisse. Ajoute la farine, la levure et le bicarbonate et mélange juste assez pour que la pâte soit homogène. Verse dans un moule beurré ou huilé d’environ 22 × 18 cm et enfourne 25 minutes, en surveillant dès 20 minutes : le centre doit rester tremblotant. Pendant la cuisson, prépare le sirop chocolat en chauffant le lait, le sucre, le cacao et le beurre jusqu’aux premiers frémissements puis coupe le feu. Dès que le gâteau sort du four, verse tout le sirop dessus et laisse absorber 10 à 15 minutes. Fais chauffer la crème, verse-la sur le chocolat, laisse fondre puis mélange et nappe le dessus. Episode 8 of Slices of the Season: Molten Lava Cake 🔥🤤 The easiest fancy dessert you’ll ever make ✨ Rich, decadent, and irresistibly chocolatey—it is guaranteed to impress!  Ingredients: -7 ounces bittersweet chocolate chips  -2 tbsp all-purpose flour -6 tbsp unsalted butter -2 large eggs -2 large egg yolks -3-4 tbsp sugar Method: 1. Preheat oven to 450°F. Butter a Bundt pan. 2. In a saucepan, combine the bittersweet chocolate and butter. Cook on medium-low heat, stirring occasionally, until mixture is melted and smooth. Set aside.  3. In a separate bowl, blend eggs, egg yolks, and sugar using an electric whisk. 4. Fold melted chocolate mixture and flour into egg mixture until well combined. 5. Pour batter into Bundt pan and bake at 450°F for 9-10 minutes. 6. Once baked, cover the Bundt pan with a plate and carefully turn it over. Let it stand for 10 seconds before lifting the pan to reveal the cake. Sprinkle some powdered sugar and enjoy with a scoop of vanilla ice cream! 💕 #baking #cake #chocolate #moltenlavacake #dessert
